display_name: Singapore succession — Wills, Intestate Succession, Probate and Administration
citation: Wills Act 1838; Intestate Succession Act 1967; Probate and Administration Act 1934 (2020 Rev Ed)

source.note: THREE Acts encoded as ONE subject against a shared ontology: they are three views of one event and share their nouns. Official texts fetched from Singapore Statutes Online as PDFs (the HTML landing page returns headings only for a long Act); every sha256 is over the PDF bytes. Full provenance in encodings/legalese/registers/source-bundle.json; re-run encodings/legalese/source/fetch-sso.py to reproduce the fetch. The Administration of Muslim Law Act 1966 is captured as a corroboration document because ISA s 2 excludes Muslim estates into it.
